Install your effect.

Run /frameui editor and open your personal link to import directly to your server. Your selected events apply immediately.

You can also install a ZIP manually:

  1. Export effectDownload your ready-to-install ZIP.
  2. Extract into plugins/FrameUI/Merge the effects/ and images/ folders. Keep your other files.
  3. Run /frameui reloadFrameUI validates definitions and rebuilds its resource pack.
  4. Test in gameAccept the refreshed pack, then run /frameui preview <id>.

A new ID creates a separate effect. An existing ID replaces that definition. Your drafts and photos stay in this browser until you export.

Delete permanently?

Connect your server

  1. Run /frameui editor in Minecraft.
  2. Open your personal editor link.
  3. Use Import to server to apply your effect and image.

Keep your Minecraft account online. Links expire after 30 minutes; a new link replaces the previous one.

Your cookie preferences

We use essential browser storage to keep your drafts and preferences. With your permission, Google Analytics helps us understand site visits.
